# Kraki for Mac 0.2.84
- Sign in and access your online computers without a mandatory device-pairing step. - Keep existing encrypted connections, keys, message signatures and replay protection compatible with previous clients. - Keep an explicit, confirmed recovery action if a saved connection can no longer be verified. Kraki never silently discards a saved verification key. - Make the Help Improve Kraki notice a non-blocking card at the bottom-right of the window. - Maintain Crypto and Pulse inside the Kraki repository, with shared cross-language tests and no encryption or transport wire-format change.
## Access-policy change
The previous “Only paired devices” access setting is retired. Updating a computer archives that setting and restores access for devices signed in to the same account. This mode trusts the server's account/device authorization; it does not protect against a malicious authorization server. Existing paired connections continue using signed v2 messages; unpaired devices keep the existing encrypted compatibility path.
Update the computer CLI to 0.38.9 first if it has the old pairing-only setting enabled. The Mac app includes CLI 0.38.9. No session history or identity keys are removed.

## What's new in Kraki 0.2.83
- **Pair your devices with your computer:** scan the computer's QR code (or, on the same Mac, it pairs by itself) and your messages are signed and checked end to end, so the relay can't read or send commands as you. Each computer's settings show its safety code and trusted devices, and you can turn on "Only paired devices". Nothing changes until you do: unpaired apps keep working. - **Help Improve Kraki:** Kraki now shares performance data, such as how quickly replies arrive. A one-time notice explains it; turn it off any time in Settings → General → Share Performance Data. - **Hover text everywhere:** every icon-only button says what it does, and a greyed-out one says why. - **Menus that work with the composer:** ⌘W, ⌘M and ⌘H are back; switching sessions is now ⌥⌘↑/⌥⌘↓ so ⌘↑/⌘↓ move in the message you're typing; the Session menu lists your session titles and has Rename and Archive. - **Menu bar octopus:** a lighter icon, and a small blue dot when something needs you. - **Approvals cover one request:** "always allow" is gone everywhere; each approval applies to that request only. - **Fixes:** replies and questions no longer get stuck or misplaced after reconnects and steering; pasted text ending in a new line stays a draft; empty Steps keep their title at the top; tool arguments show readable values; Account Usage follows your dark/light theme; the working dots in the sidebar use the right blue in dark mode.

## What's new in Kraki 0.2.82
- **Pick up where you left off:** opening a conversation with new messages (a red dot, or from a notification) now starts at the first message you haven't read when the new part is longer than one screen. If it fits, you land at the bottom as before. It stays there while more arrives, until you scroll, tap ↓ or send. - **Smoother replies:** while a reply streams, the conversation glides up line by line instead of jumping. A reply that arrives all at once slides in smoothly, with no jump.
